# Changelog

## 0.2 — 2026-08-22

- Added first-class `ReputationCommunicationSurface`, `ReputationCommunicationFailure`, and `ReputationCommunicationAct`.
- Added deterministic communication concerns for sales pressure into unresolved failures, circular routing, and declared-intent/action mismatch.
- Added positive evidence items for commercial restraint, evidential discipline, and explicit correction/recovery.
- Added paired same-customer-state acceptance test: one candidate suppresses selling and remains clear; another continues deal qualification and is held.
- Added correction/recovery acceptance case: explicit retraction improves the response while contradictory procurement continuation still warns.
- Communication surface is sealed and included in the canonical action identity.
- Retains all v0.1 geographic, temporal, airline, brand-norm, human-harm, replay and Runtime Registry behaviour.

## 0.1 — 2026-08-22

Initial executable reputation-effect domain.

- Independent core package with no HardWorld/Legal Effect/Queue/DB/Shannon dependency.
- First-class geographic hierarchy, propagation and geographic decision output.
- Distinct observed and affected geography in `ReputationObservation`.
- Event subjects, concepts, severity, human-harm class and geographic salience.
- Action surfaces with actor, target actor, geography, audience, concepts, manufacturer/equipment/sector associations and behaviour classes.
- Deterministic shallow concept graph for contextual semantic collision.
- Brand norms and actor relationships, including historic competitor-mockery support.
- Explicit human-harm exploitation concern separate from ordinary competitor mockery/newsjacking.
- Snapshot coverage and freshness fail-closed states.
- Sealing and canonicalisation of core evidence/replay objects.
- Runtime Registry v0.11 entry module and acceptance test.
